Never locate the record section by the first \\u0060\\u003C/details\\u003E\\u0060, and never search for the criteria heading across the whole body. \\u0060GitHubIssueBody.Find\\u0060 walks the fenced block structurally (the fence is sized by \\u0060RelayedText.FenceFor\\u0060 to outrun anything inside it); that is the only safe anchor. Two round-two tests pin it.\\n- **Second non-obvious shape:** adding a Jira arm means a new \\u0060TryReadRecordYaml\\u0060/\\u0060WithRecord\\u0060 equivalent in Jira\\u0027s own markup plus one arm in \\u0060TaskRecordAdoption.Read\\u0060 \\u2014 \\u0060TaskRecord\\u0060 itself needs nothing.
